results.title: American Troll
results.overview: American Troll is a story about sticking to your convictions, and the willingness to suffer for them. It is a tale of a decade long, legal battle between the Gabriel family with a deaf, singing child and comedian Mike Ward from Montreal, Canada. A monumental free speech case in Canadian history! This documentary is a reminder that, in the face of adversity, maintaining strong beliefs can lead to personal growth, mockery, depression, grey hairs, unwanted attention, online cruelty, repeating mistakes, and very expensive lawyer bills.

results.title: Thread Bound
results.overview: When a skeptical teen meets a mysterious boy with a healing gift, they begin a journey to unravel the painful threads of their past, and discover that something greater may be connecting it all.

results.title: Deathkeeper
results.overview: Cursed to age decades each time he saves a life, a reclusive angel is drawn to a possessed woman hunted by a charming demon in disguise -forcing him to confront the only way to reclaim his youth: killing.

results.title: Argonauts at the End of History
results.original_title: Argonauts at the End of History
results.overview: In 1989, with the world on the brink of a massive upheaval, a group of Soviet sailors built their own boat and entered a perilous around-the-world race. Told through their own words and layers of haunting archival footage, we follow as they navigate wild seas, political turmoil, and personal tragedy.

results.title: A Girl in the Gas Station
results.overview: It is the story of a man who lives a solitary and routine life despite being married, and when he casually meets a younger girl, he begins a clandestine relationship that will unleash jealousy, revenge, and death.

results.title: A Survivor's Tale
results.overview: 1542, the year of Jacques Cartier's second mission to Canada. Pregnant by a man other than her future husband, the expedition's commander, the young Marguerite de la Rocque is abandoned on a deserted island off the coast of Newfoundland with the man who raped her and his maid. She will remain there for two years, surviving hunger, cold, despair, and madness.

results.title: Chameleon
results.overview: 17-year-old twins Mia and Jakob are distraught: their father died unexpectedly the night after his 50th birthday. Suicide, at least according to the police investigation. Mia and Jakob cannot accept this; unlike their mother, they are convinced that someone else must be responsible.

results.title: Yoshi
results.overview: A disillusioned young man contends with the 21st century.

results.title: Women as Lovers
results.overview: Although hostess Brigitte and life-loving schoolgirl Paula only meet in person once, their fates and lives are closely intertwined.

results.title: Aïe Aïe A.I.
results.overview: We follow Léo, a parisian inventor, as he showcases his last invention in an art museum. It happens to be a robot that can turn simple sketches into "masterpieces". But things don't go as planned as the visitors start feeding it with the museum artworks... before this one spots a tastier meal.

results.title: It Pays to Belong
results.overview: A documentary about The Embassy, the iconic duo at the heart of Gothenburg's influential indie scene that emerged in the early 2000s.

results.title: За Палыча! 2
results.overview: Artyom Golub was once a rich kid, confident his father would "solve" any problem. But life put everything in its place: after an accident, Tema joins the Airborne Forces. Upon his return, he works, raises his daughter, and tries to live by his conscience. Meanwhile, his grandfather, the legendary paratrooper Palych, grows apple trees and dreams of peace. However, businessman Vasiliy arrives in Podgorny, wanting to tear down the monument to the Liberator Soldier and build a shopping mall. Palych protests, then disappears. To save his grandfather and uncover the truth behind the conflict, Tyoma reassembles the paratroopers.

results.title: Sleep Through Summer
results.overview: An incarcerated man is forced to take a dance class as part of a mysterious rehabilitation program.

results.title: Butt/Stuff
results.overview: Two anxious roommates fight over the most hallowed of queer spaces… the bathroom.

results.title: No Fairy Dust
results.overview: It follows Marija an ice skater who lives with her father. When her father's girlfriend moves in, Marija realizes that she cannot trust her. The love of a young businessman will give her the strength to accept herself and her sexuality.

results.title: Standout: The Ben Kjar Story
results.overview: Standout tells the powerful story of Ben Kjar, born with Crouzon Syndrome, a rare craniofacial disorder. From birth, doctors warn that his life will be overshadowed by limitations. Ben yearns for an ordinary life free from the harsh scrutiny he faces daily.  However, each experience of adversity, including relentless bullying and a series of painful surgeries, ignites a fire within him. Wrestling becomes his proving ground, a place where he learns to transform his facial difference into a source of power. Determined to succeed, he pushes himself relentlessly, breaking through physical, social, and even romantic barriers that once seemed insurmountable. But as unexpected challenges arise and ridicule resurfaces, Ben finds himself at a defining crossroads: fade into the background of a “normal” life, or fully embrace his unique path and boldly stand out.

results.title: Hand Me Downs
results.overview: For nearly three decades, Death Skateboards has carved out its own place in British skateboarding. As the UK’s oldest skateboard company, its legacy has been shaped by the generations of riders who have carried it forward, each leaving their own mark on the team and the culture surrounding it. Through its past, present and future, the film explores how a legacy is built, passed down and kept alive, and what it means to be part of something that extends far beyond skateboarding itself.

results.title: Jackpot
results.overview: When Ghanaian cleaner Ebenezer finds a winning lottery ticket, his dream of going to university suddenly seems within reach. But when he is unable to provide identification to claim the prize, he can no longer stay under the radar and is forced to take risks.

results.title: Anda
results.overview: ANDA is a visually haunting and lyrical feature film that blends Nordic folklore with surrealist storytelling and modern themes. The film follows an elderly woman whose mother returns-decades younger than expected. Her search for answers pulls her into a dreamlike realm where myth and reality entwine. As she unearths long-buried secrets, she must carefully navigate the brittle boundary between inheritance and freedom, confronting the cost of power and the illusions of love. Through the intimate lens of a mother-daughter relationship, ANDA explores the longing for youth, desire, and the enduring myths we live by
